note: Written down before any of the data they are tested on existed. Do not edit a rule after its freeze time; add a new rule with its own frozen_at instead. Feature names are those of explore.py (avg_trade = 1h volume / 1h txns in USD, mc_high = highest MC the scanner has seen, a lower bound of GMGN's ATH MC).

rules.name: F0 baseline: every tradable token (liq>=5K, vol24h>=10K)
F2 fast momentum, big trades, early
F4 deep liquidity, early (GMGN fields only)
F5 big trades + buy pressure, early
F6 just migrated / first minutes (speed game)
F7 old-report revival preset (expected to lose; control)
